question: DEPARTURE_SPELLINGS enumerated four names and called them 'every spelling the corpus uses'. CH-0169 found seven more by exact match and refused to sweep them, because 12 of the 62 fields are a log10 of a residual or a study's own answer. Which names ARE the rule's quantity, which are not, and how is each exclusion PROVED rather than asserted? And: remove the corpus's one wall clock, whose three readers make the removal a schema change.

findings: A LIST IS A CENSUS THAT STOPPED, AND SO IS THE CENSUS THAT SAYS SO, BECAUSE BOTH SEARCH FOR A NAME WHERE THE RULE IS ABOUT A SHAPE. DEPARTURE_SPELLINGS enumerated four; CH-0169 found seven more by exact match; a shape census — a leaf key inside a reproductions/convergence record whose NAME DENOTES A DISCREPANCY — finds fourteen, i.e. 75 fields in 8 files against the published 62 in 6. The three it adds are two COMPOUNDS of the rule's own word (T-60's convergence[*].multiplierDeparture and gradientDeparture, which an exact-match list cannot see) and a third logarithm (observedOrder, in T-1d and T-1e). CH-0192.

THE EXCLUSIONS ARE THE EXPENSIVE HALF, AND EACH ONE IS A MEASUREMENT. Two significant digits on residualExponent = -11.0931 is -11: a residual of 1e-11 where the solve produced 8.070e-12, +23.9 %, and the three-row node-spacing axis collapses to one constant. On coverageErrorExponent = -14.1669 it is +46.9 %, and -14.5744 rounds the OTHER way to -15 (-62.5 %), so two rows a factor of 2.56 apart in the quantity render a factor of TEN apart. observedOrder is a logarithm of their RATIO and the answer of the axis: CLAUDE.md quotes exactly these four values as 2.08-2.32, 1.59 and 1.11, so sweeping them would put the corpus's own prose outside the file it is read from. worstResidual is a LENGTH in nm carrying the decision `covalent`. residual and coverageError are ABSOLUTE.

TWO OF THE NINE INHERITED JUDGEMENTS ARE WRONG, ONE IN EACH DIRECTION, AND BOTH BECAUSE A SPELLING WAS READ AS A STUDY. relativeMovement was excluded as 'P-18's own determined-precision measurement'; P-18 declares it at three digits and emits it OUTSIDE both departure records, where the record qualifier already protects it — exactly as it protects T-193's volts. The fields the census counts belong to T-108 and are abs(coarse - fine)/coarse over a refinement, with coarse and fine emitted beside them, and T-182 and T-189 ALREADY emit the same key in the same record at two significant digits. The corpus had classified it correctly twice before the challenge classified it wrongly once. worstResidual was left 'needs reading' when the reading is one KDoc line.

A WALL CLOCK CANNOT BE FOUND BY FIELD NAME, AND CAN BE FOUND EXACTLY IN THE SOURCE. T-7 emits waterViscosityPascalSeconds and five model times; T-119 a configured pauseSecondsBetweenQueries. A grep of System.nanoTime/System.currentTimeMillis over src/main/kotlin, following the variable to its use, is exact: 31 studies measure their own elapsed time and exactly ONE put it in a result file. brush/DeterminedPrecisionStudy states the discipline in its own KDoc — 'the seconds go to stdout only', 'cost is counted in SCF SOLVES, not seconds' — which the other thirty follow without saying so.

REMOVING A FIELD IS A SCHEMA CHANGE AND THE PROOF IS CHEAPER THAN THE RUN, BUT THE RUN IS WHAT FINDS WHAT THE PROOF WAS NOT ABOUT. All three readers of T-172 take a NAMED LOOKUP in cheapBounds and never deserialise parameters, so the removal is invisible by construction. Running them anyway (C-0110) returned two byte-identical files and one carrying a wording change that a --committed control run attributes entirely to HEAD's own code — a deterministic staleness from iteration 31, in a file whose emitter and result were committed together and disagree.

THE `wide` LINE IS DOCUMENTED AS A CEILING ON THE CLASS AND THE CLASS EXCEEDS IT BY 68 OF 75. It is keyed on the substring 'departure', so 7 of this task's 54 gated fields are inside it and 47 are not, and none of the 21 excluded ones are. It is the line a reader differences against the gate to know that a clean gate means something. Retained, and re-described as a bound on ONE SPELLING FAMILY; the ceiling on the class is tools/T-225-census.py, which searches for the shape and requires a classification. CH-0193.

A MUTATION TEST HAS TWO DIRECTIONS ONCE A PREDICATE CARRIES EXCLUSIONS, AND THE SECOND IS THE ONE NOTHING ELSE HERE TESTS. C-0127's standard is that narrowing must fail a named test; a predicate that can only be widened becomes a PATTERN, which is what CH-0169 refused. Measured over 31 GATE_TESTS: 9 fail if narrowed to T-214's four, 15 to C-0129's leaf name, 7 if the record qualifier is dropped, and 6 if the six exclusions are swept in — and every one of the 18 classifications fails at least one named test on its own, which a whole-predicate count can hide.
